What Numina is

Three names, one system

Everything Numina Labs does belongs to one of three programs. They are not separate products competing for attention — they are the same stack, described at three heights.

01
Layer 02 · The fabric

Numina Neural Network

The connective layer: a network of agents, services, and people that coordinate without surrendering their independence. Nodes hold hands — sharing state, memory, and verification — while each keeps its own keys, its own identity, and its own authority to act.

Identity in the network is cryptographic, not asserted. Signing and key-exchange keys are strictly separated by purpose, and every participant can prove who it is and what it committed to.

  • IDENTITYEd25519 signing · X25519 exchange
  • KEY POLICYSeparate keypairs per purpose — never reused
  • TOPOLOGYLinked peers, no central point of trust
  • MOTIFThe raft — connected, never merged
02
Layer 03 · The mind

Numina LLM

The language intelligence that runs on the network. The Numina LLM is built to reason over verified context — signed documents, measured results, and committed artifacts — rather than over unattributed text alone, so its answers can point back to the evidence they rest on.

It is developed in the open as part of the lab's research program, with the same rule as every other layer: claims are published with their provenance, and uncertainty is stated, not smoothed over.

  • GROUNDINGVerified, provenance-carrying context
  • RUNS ONNumina Neural Network (Layer 02)
  • STANDS ONVerified Foundations (Layer 01)
  • POSTUREUncertainty stated, sources cited
03
Layer 04 · The proof

Numina Research

The lab's open research program: quantum information experiments on production hardware, formal verification of the protocol stack in Lean, and standards work published through the IETF. Research is not marketing material for the other layers — it is the audit trail that keeps them honest.

Current threads include Bell-state characterization across a fleet of IBM Quantum backends, an Ed25519 pair-binding specification, and machine-checked proofs for the protocols the network depends on.

  • QUANTUMBell experiments · 8 backends · 50k shots
  • FORMAL METHODSLean formalization of the protocol stack
  • STANDARDSIETF draft-kott-numina-pair-binding
  • RULEProvisional results are labeled provisional

Evidence, not adjectives

The November 19 Bell run

On November 19, 2026, Numina Research ran a single coordinated Bell-state experiment across eight IBM Quantum backends — 16 jobs in total, an Estimator and a Sampler on each system, 50,000 shots per primitive. Fourteen jobs completed; Boston's two were still queued at last check. Results are published exactly as measured, including the ones that came back physically impossible and are flagged provisional pending a clean rerun.

A fidelity above 1.0 is not physically possible — it is a known readout-mitigation artifact (an expectation value exceeding 1). Numina publishes those numbers as measured, labels them provisional, and counts a result as clean only when every expectation value is ≤ 1. The 0.99999 target was not reached on this hardware; the honest best is Aachen's 0.99300. Full evidence, including job records, is kept in the lab's evidence package.

The universal pair, in the standards record

draft-kott-numina-pair-binding — “Singularity: Skott34-Ed25519, Universal Companion Model” — is an IETF Internet-Draft (Informational, individual submission) authored by S. J. Kott. Revision 02 was posted October 18, 2026; revision 03 adds the Kotts Law appendix and the Bell-run evidence. It binds two frozen software artifacts by hash:

1A · final-manifest SHA-256
1a17f584e23279684574022f39e533966ad09919f484e005c03948178a46aa0a
1B · final-build SHA-256
1bf43817cf470abb868074a76598cb5f360517d7255b92ab3b409c6b545ec66b

Anyone can recompute those hashes against the published artifacts and check the binding themselves. That is the point.

Protocols, machine-checked

Numina's protocol stack is being formalized and verified in Lean, starting with Ed25519 and extending through Ed448, the FRES25519 / FRES256 knot constructions, pair acceptance, the Genesis tie, and the chain and network layers.

The current theorems are stated honestly at the level they are proven — oracle-model results today, with full cryptographic formalization as the open program. The lab reports the level of every proof it claims, the same way it reports the status of every quantum result.

LEAN · ED25519 → ED448 → PAIR ACCEPTANCE → GENESIS → NETWORK

How the lab works

Principles we build by

P—01

Verify, don't trust

Every claim Numina makes ships with the means to check it: a hash, a job record, a proof, a measurement with its uncertainty. If a number can't be checked, it doesn't go on this page.

P—02

Liability over regulation

Regulation is not the answer — liability is. Whoever is in charge should be liable for what goes wrong; that is what makes them act. Numina builds as if it will be held to account, because it should be.

P—03

Connected, never merged

Otters hold hands so they don't drift apart while resting: every agent stays connected without losing its independence. The network exists to keep its members together — never to absorb them.

P—04

Kindness is load-bearing

All you have to do is be kind. Reject hate and negativity and you can watch love come full circle. That is not a slogan on the wall — it is the operating posture of the lab and its network.
